predict.question: B has 90 hours; each task requires 20 work plus 20 coordination hours. How many work hours does B complete?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: The Mythical Man-Month warns that adding people can impose training and communication costs.
modelBoundary: A finishes {A} work hours; B finishes {B}. B has more total hours, but each complete 20-hour task now also costs 20 coordination hours. Person-hours and indivisible tasks are invented; no staffing effect is estimated.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
